description: This Java source file defines the GlobalProperty class, representing a key-value pair for global configuration within the OpenMRS health information system. It includes fields for property metadata, datatype handling, privileges, and change history, along with constructors, getters, setters, and overrides for serialization and debugging.

classes.name: GlobalProperty
